defects.resolution: C001-REQ-206 and C001-TS-207 except the gate question of C001-REQ-802 (G2/G3 re-approved 2026-10-11)

defects.resolution: C001-IF-13 section 1 documents the two impact lines of sdd gate show for a phase in revision (G2/G3 re-approved 2026-10-11)

defects.summary: IF-07 §2 wires SubagentStop to 'trace --quiet --write --active', but the IF-01 trace row is '<NNN> [--write] [--json]' (no --active, <NNN> required) and trace exits 1/2 on gaps or errors, while SubagentStop needs exit 0 (exit 2 blocks the subagent). T-052 implemented trace --active: every active change, always exit 0, silent outside a workspace. Proposed: add '--active' to the IF-01 trace row with that behaviour.
defects.resolution: IF-01 trace row gains --active (G2 2026-10-12); implemented in T-052 (43d044f)

defects.summary: The path guard denies the agent-memory writes of A1/A2 (memory: project, IF-09, OA-13): Claude Code saves them with Write into <repo>/.claude/agent-memory/architect-sdd-<agent>/, outside .sdd/ (live check, Claude Code 2.1.295, sdd-cartographer on haiku). Proposed: REQ-1103/IF-07 exception letting an Architect agent write only its own memory folder .claude/agent-memory/architect-sdd-<agent>/ (same normalisation), or drop memory from A1/A2.
defects.resolution: REQ-1103/IF-07 revised (G2 2026-10-12); guard allows the agent's own memory folder (ef95def)

defects.summary: With --project-from-cwd, Serena 1.7.0 activates no project in a folder without .git or .serena/project.yml, and then the read-only mode's exclusions are not applied: tools/list shows 23 tools incl. replace_symbol_body, rename_symbol, replace_in_files, write_memory (probe 2026-10-12). Agents still cannot call them (REQ-1007 grants 5 tools by name), but REQ-1006's 'exposes only the read-only tools' fails outside git. Verified fix: '--project .' (Claude Code starts MCP servers in the project folder) gives the 7 read-only tools with or without git. Proposed: replace --project-from-cwd with --project . in REQ-1006/IF-14 §4/TS-1007.
defects.resolution: REQ-1006/TS-1007/IF-14 §4 revised (G2/G3 2026-10-12); .mcp.json uses --project . (c496b49); 7 read-only tools with and without git

defects.summary: Enhancement (P-01, 2026-10-13): agents never commit, so .sdd/ history depends on the user remembering. Add an opt-in flag to sdd gate approve (e.g. --commit) that, after a successful approval, commits only the .sdd/ files of the change and the workspace status files with a message naming the change, gate and approver ('CHG-NNN: G2 (spec) approved by <name>'); refuses with a clear error outside a git repository or when other staged changes exist. Done by the deterministic CLI, so the agents' read-only git allowlist stays unchanged; the conductor passes the flag only when P-01 opted in (constitution or per-gate answer). Needs REQ/AC/TS in CAP-08, IF-01 row, gate-protocol skill and the commands.

Serena writes .serena/ (project.yml, cache, memories) into any repository where a session starts with the plugin enabled, until sdd serena-config has run (only /architect:init and /architect:doctor run it): observed 2026-10-12 in this repository after installing the packaged plugin. REQ-1013 assumes init/doctor run before Serena's first start, but the MCP server starts with every session, also in unrelated repositories (spirit of REQ-912). Proposed: launch Serena through the CLI (.mcp.json command node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/sdd.mjs serena-launch, which writes the config into ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/serena when missing and then runs serena with the IF-14 §4 arguments, stdio passed through), so the config always exists before Serena starts.
defects.resolution: REQ-1013 revised (G2/G3 2026-10-13); Serena started through sdd serena-launch (91f7bcf); TS-1015 passes

defects.summary: Dogfood finding (T-070, 2026-10-13): the Bash allowlist of IF-07 §3 accepts the version probe 'node -v' but not 'node --version', so the cartographer's toolchain record could not show Node's version (it tried --version, like every other probe). Proposed: accept both spellings for node (and '-v'/'--version' consistently for the other probes where the tool supports them).
defects.resolution: Fixed by CHG-002 C002-T-008 (3997daf): the bash guard allows exactly 'node --version' and bare 'sdd' (C002-REQ-503)

Found in C002-T-004: the structure check PLG-VER-001 (root package.json version differs from plugin.json, C002-ADR-004) is implemented but named in no errors.md / check catalogue. Batch with D-004.
